meta.source: Excise Tax Act (GST/HST) and provincial rates published by the Canada Revenue Agency
meta.note: CBSA collects the 5 % GST on commercial imports. The provincial part of the HST on goods imported into a participating province is self-assessed by importers that are not registrants able to claim full input tax credits; PST, QST and RST are provincial and not collected at the border.

gst.source: Excise Tax Act, s. 212 and s. 215 (value for duty plus duties)

exciseChapters.note: Beverages: excise duty on wine and spirits (Excise Act, 2001) and on beer (Excise Act) may apply.
Tobacco and vaping products: excise duty and stamping apply.
Automobiles: the excise tax on fuel-inefficient vehicles and air conditioners may apply (Excise Tax Act, Schedule I).
